# Task 7.3 — Wire `BundleConfig.sourcemap`/`target` and replace line-scanned `.d.ts` emitter with `oxc_isolated_declarations`

## Objective

Honor `BundleConfig.sourcemap` and `BundleConfig.target` in `Bundler::build_internal` while removing the 5 unread `BundleConfig` fields (`FE-01`), replace the broken line-scanning `IsolatedDeclarationsGenerator` in `dts.rs` with `oxc_isolated_declarations::IsolatedDeclarations`, split CSS minification into `css.rs` and declarations into `declarations.rs`, and delete the unused `encode_ssr_worker_frame` function (`FE-03`).

## Context

- `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/config.rs:11-108` defines `BundleConfig` with `entry`, `outdir`, `minify`, `sourcemap`, `target`, `external`, `define`, `format`, `tree_shaking`, and `splitting`. `Bundler::build_internal` (`src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/bundler.rs:211-294`) always calls `TransformOptions::default()` (ignoring `config.target`) and `CodegenOptions { minify: config.minify, ..CodegenOptions::default() }` (ignoring `config.sourcemap`), even though `BuildOrchestrator._run_native` (`src/py/vertebra/build/_orchestrator.py:163`) passes `sourcemap=True`. The `external`, `define`, `format`, `tree_shaking`, and `splitting` fields are never read anywhere (`FE-01`).
- `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/dts.rs:34-92` parses the AST with `oxc_parser` only to discard `parsed.program` and scan `source_text.lines()`, which produces invalid `.d.ts` output for any multi-line exported function signature or multi-line interface (`FE-03`).
- `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/dts.rs:124-134` defines `encode_ssr_worker_frame`, which has zero callers in Rust or Python and uses `{component:?}` Debug formatting instead of JSON string escaping (`FE-03`).

## Steps

1. Write failing Rust tests first (`regression_tdd`):
   - In `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/bundler.rs` tests, add `test_build_writes_sourcemap_and_respects_target`: build a `.ts` file with `sourcemap = true` and `target = "es2022"`, asserting that `<outdir>/<stem>.js.map` is written to disk, `BuildResult.outputs` includes both `<stem>.js` and `<stem>.js.map`, and `<stem>.js` ends with `//# sourceMappingURL=<stem>.js.map`. Also assert that an invalid `target` string returns `Err(BundlerError::Transform(_))`.
   - In `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/declarations.rs` tests, add `test_emit_dts_multiline_function_and_interface`: pass a multi-line TypeScript function declaration (`export function greet(\n  name: string,\n  count: number,\n): string {\n  return name.repeat(count);\n}`) and multi-line `export interface User {\n  id: number;\n  /** @internal */\n  secret: string;\n}` and assert that `emit_dts` produces valid `export declare function greet(name: string, count: number): string;` and strips `@internal` properties when `strip_internal = true`.
2. In `src/rs/Cargo.toml` and `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/Cargo.toml`:
   - Add `oxc_isolated_declarations = "0.155"` to `[workspace.dependencies]` in `src/rs/Cargo.toml` and `oxc_isolated_declarations = { workspace = true }` to `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/Cargo.toml`.
3. In `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/config.rs`:
   - Remove the 5 unread fields (`external`, `define`, `format`, `tree_shaking`, `splitting`) and `use std::collections::HashMap;` from `BundleConfig`, keeping `entry`, `outdir`, `minify`, `sourcemap`, and `target`.
4. In `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/bundler.rs`:
   - In `build_internal` (`bundler.rs:245-294`), construct `TransformOptions::from_target(&config.target).map_err(|e| BundlerError::Transform(vec![e]))?` instead of `TransformOptions::default()`.
   - When `config.sourcemap` is `true`, set `source_map_path: Some(PathBuf::from(&entry_Filename))` on `CodegenOptions`, serialize `codegen_result.map` via `map.to_json_string()` to `<outdir>/<stem>.js.map`, append `\n//# sourceMappingURL=<stem>.js.map\n` to the emitted `.js` file, and push an `OutputFile` entry for `<stem>.js.map` into `outputs`.
5. Split `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/dts.rs` into `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/declarations.rs` and `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/css.rs`, and delete `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/dts.rs`:
   - In `declarations.rs`, implement `IsolatedDeclarationsGenerator::emit_dts` using `oxc_isolated_declarations::{IsolatedDeclarations, IsolatedDeclarationsOptions}` over `&parsed.program` and `Codegen::new().build(&isolated_ret.program).code`, returning `Err(BundlerError::Transform(...))` when `isolated_ret.errors` is non-empty and `strip_internal` requires strict isolated declarations, or emitting the generated `.d.ts` AST cleanly.
   - In `css.rs`, move `minify_css` and its unit test from `dts.rs`.
   - Delete `encode_ssr_worker_frame` (`dts.rs:124-134`) and Remove its registration from `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/lib.rs:19,38`.
   - Update `src/rs/vertebra-bundler/src/lib.rs` to declare `pub mod css; pub mod declarations;` and re-export `css::minify_css` and `declarations::IsolatedDeclarationsGenerator`.

## Verification

- **Initial failing reproduction (`regression_tdd`)**:
  - Run `cd src/rs && cargo test -p vertebra-bundler` with the new sourcemap and multi-line `.d.ts` tests and confirm both fail before the implementation.
- **Post-fix verification**:
  - `cd src/rs && cargo test -p vertebra-bundler`
  - `cd src/rs && cargo clippy -p vertebra-bundler --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  - `make dev && uv run pytest src/py/tests/unit/framework/test_orchestrator.py -q`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `BundleConfig` contains only `entry`, `outdir`, `minify`, `sourcemap`, and `target` (all 5 unread fields removed).
- [x] `Bundler::build` honors `config.target` via `TransformOptions::from_target` and writes `<stem>.js.map` + `sourceMappingURL` when `config.sourcemap` is `true`.
- [x] `IsolatedDeclarationsGenerator::emit_dts` uses `oxc_isolated_declarations` and emits valid declarations for multi-line functions, interfaces, and types.
- [x] `dts.rs` and `encode_ssr_worker_frame` are deleted; `declarations.rs` and `css.rs` pass all unit and Clippy checks.
